presets.name: Silvery BBD flange shimmer
presets.desc: Gentle BBD flanger, moderate regen, 60 % sweep: a shimmering, almost chorus-like swirl on clean chords

refs.why: Alex Lifeson's Electric Mistress shimmer on the clean arpeggios
Andy Summers' flanger-like chord swirl (studio unit disputed)

presets.notes: README application 'Electric Mistress shimmer'; manual/length restate the mode's 0.5 – 8 ms span (they are not set by the mode)

presets.name: Jet-plane hard rock flange
presets.desc: BBD flanger with a log sweep that lingers high and strong regen: the whooshing jet on a cranked riff

refs.why: Eddie's MXR Flanger on the main riff

presets.notes: README 'Jet flanger' starting point; log LFO from the Grey mode, a little loop drive so the regen peaks round off on distortion

presets.name: Galloping driven flange
presets.desc: Faster, resonant BBD flange on a driven, palm-muted gallop: the notes whoosh and growl as the sweep passes

refs.why: Roger Fisher's custom-built flanger on the galloping riff

presets.notes: Shorter length keeps the notches high and metallic; rate 0.45 Hz makes the sweep audible inside a bar

presets.name: Huge slow sweep
presets.desc: Very wide 35:1 BBD sweep at 0.08 Hz: the comb travels from bright fizz down to a deep throat over long phrases
presets.notes: README 'Huge slow sweep'; 0.4 – 14 ms restates the mode's span; loop low cut keeps long delays from booming

presets.name: Cold post-punk flange
presets.desc: Medium-rate BBD flange on bright clean guitar: a cold, glassy, hollow swirl under a repeating figure

refs.why: Mike Hedges stacked several flangers on the guitar

presets.notes: Negative feedback gives hollow notches rather than metallic peaks: colder than the silver shimmer

presets.name: Slow clean intro flange
presets.desc: Slow, deep stereo flange on a clean picked intro: a wide, moving swirl before the heavy part enters
presets.notes: Opposite L/R sweeps (180°) for width on a stereo clean channel

presets.name: Touch-sensitive funk flange
presets.desc: The pick sweeps the flanger: each strum jumps the comb up, it falls back as the note decays
presets.notes: env_sens -25 dB: the sweep starts 30 dB below and tops out at -25 dBFS peaks; lower it for a quiet guitar

presets.name: Expression-pedal flange
presets.desc: No LFO: the foot sweeps the comb through the EXP pedal on Manual, exponential so it moves evenly in pitch
presets.notes: In Pedal mode the delay equals Manual (0.05 – 30 ms): map the EXP pedal to manual; 1 ms puts the first notch at 500 Hz

presets.name: Robotic metallic resonator
presets.desc: A fixed 2 ms comb at near-maximum negative regen: a hollow, ringing robotic resonance on any source
presets.notes: Negative feedback puts peaks at k/τ = 500 Hz multiples; loop drive and filters keep the -2 dB regen safe; EXP on manual retunes it

presets.name: Tape through-zero phrase flange
presets.desc: Two-tape flanging: wet equals dry, the sweep passes through zero and cancels, no regen: the 60s psychedelic whoosh

refs.why: Olympic's tape flanging on the bridge, credited to George Chkiantz

presets.notes: README 'Tape flanging'; Tape TZ delays the dry 1 ms (reported latency); bass_keep is ignored in this mode

presets.name: Through-zero drum bus jet
presets.desc: Through-zero flange with a touch of regen on a drum bus or loop: cymbals and snare sweep in a jet-like whoosh
presets.notes: TZ+ with regen: the zero crossing gives the jet's dramatic cancellation; loop low cut keeps the kick out of the feedback

presets.name: Zero-latency tape-style flange
presets.desc: Near-through-zero flange with the dry all-passed instead of delayed: the tape whoosh live, with no latency
presets.notes: README 'Same, live, no latency'; wet = dry for the deepest cancellation

presets.name: Psychedelic vocal flange
presets.desc: Subtle zero-latency flange on a vocal: a slow, airy phasey sweep on held words, intelligibility kept
presets.notes: Wet -8 dB keeps the cancellation partial so words stay clear; short length keeps the notches in the upper mids and air

presets.name: Bass flange, lows untouched
presets.desc: BBD flange on bass above 150 Hz only: the low end stays dry and mono while the growl and pick sweep
presets.notes: README 'Bass' application: bass_keep 150 Hz complementary split

presets.name: Endless rising flange
presets.desc: Barber-pole flanger: the comb seems to rise forever with no reset, building tension before a drop
presets.notes: README 'Endless rise'; dual crossfaded ramps (Esqueda) so no wrap is heard

presets.name: Endless falling flange
presets.desc: Barber-pole flanger falling forever: a sinking, disorienting sweep for breakdowns and transitions
presets.notes: Slower than the rise: a fall reads better at about 10 s per apparent cycle

presets.name: Two-bar tempo-locked sweep
presets.desc: Log-shaped BBD flange locked to the host: one full sweep every two bars, in phase with the song
presets.notes: README 'Tempo-locked sweep'; phase follows the host position so the peak lands on the same beat every time
